title: CPF Module Schema: Virtual Machine Scale Set (Flexible Orchestration mode) module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-orchestratedvirtualmachinescaleset'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.
module_name: Virtual Machine Scale Set (Flexible Orchestration mode) module

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

Possible values are `Replace` or `Reimage`. Defaults to `Replace`." })
